say:3:1028228001:1.text: Miss Florabelle, I'm sorry... I shouldn't have snuck out of the academy...
say:3:1028228001:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔老师，对不起，我不该偷偷溜出学院。但是……

say:4:1028228002:0.text: It's alright. I heard from Chippy that you were seeking out your special gift, right?
say:4:1028228002:0.source_cn: 没关系，我听满满说了，你是为了寻找天赋，对不对？

say:5:1028228003:1.text: But after searching so long, I still haven't discovered anything...
say:5:1028228003:1.source_cn: 嗯，可找了这么大一圈，还是什么都没找到……

say:6:1028228004:1.text: Randy, like you, I can neither speak to the wind nor wield a sword. When I was young, I felt lost for a long time. I was constantly wondering what my gift was.
say:6:1028228004:1.source_cn: 兰迪，我和你一样，既不懂风语也不会剑术。小的时候，我也...

say:7:1028228005:1.text: So, how did you find your gift?

say:8:1028228006:0.text: Although it took a long time, I finally discovered that I was meant to look after children like you and be there to guide all of you.
say:8:1028228006:0.source_cn: 嗯，虽然花了不少时间，但还是找到了，我的天赋——就是和...

say:9:1028228007:0.text: Misarte has endowed this forest with endless possibilities, and we're all unique. So far, you've only tried three times, so don't give up.
say:9:1028228007:0.source_cn: 你看，弥萨忒赋予这片森林无限的可能，所以万物各有芬芳。...

say:10:1028228008:1.text: But without the talent to join the Windwhisperers or the Thorned Guards, what can I do to help anyone?
say:10:1028228008:1.source_cn: 可是，如果没有足够的天赋加入风语者、荆棘卫队或巡游队，...

say:11:1028228009:0.text: Have you thought about becoming an herbalist, chef, architect, or even a scribe?
say:11:1028228009:0.source_cn: 成为一名植物学者、厨师、建筑师……或者是充满想象力的作...

say:12:1028228010:0.text: The forest nurtures all different types of growth. These differences are what make the forest beautiful.
say:12:1028228010:0.source_cn: 丛林中盛开着所有的花，生长着不同的树木，正是这些不同，...

say:13:1028228011:0.text: I might know another way to help you find your calling.
say:13:1028228011:0.source_cn: 好啦……你看，我还有个办法能帮你找到天赋！

say:14:1028228012:1.text: If you love flowers so much, surely you know that Misarte does as well?
say:14:1028228012:1.source_cn: 你那么喜爱花草，肯定知道弥萨忒也钟爱美丽的花朵，对吧？

say:16:1028228014:0.text: Well, it might be a good idea to plant some more! I'm sure you'll feel the joy Misarte feels when they bloom. Maybe then your gift will be revealed.
say:16:1028228014:0.source_cn: 那么，不妨多种些花吧！当花朵盛放时，你一定能感受到弥萨...

say:17:1028228015:0.text: Is it really possible, Miss Florabelle?
say:17:1028228015:0.source_cn: ……真的吗？！芙拉贝尔老师，真的可以吗？

say:22:1028228019:1.text: Thank you! When the time comes, I'll give Misarte the most beautiful flowers as an offering!
say:22:1028228019:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！到时候，我会向弥萨忒贡上最漂亮的鲜花的！
